verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains substantive text quoted from the public guidance surface: nj.gov/treasury/revenue/, gettingregistered.shtml, and the njportal.com BusinessRegistration and BusinessFormation pages. This implies those pages returned readable content without login or keys. However, no item explicitly addresses bot walls, CAPTCHAs, JS-only rendering, or behavior toward an identified agent user agent, so reachability is only inferred. missing for 10: explicit evidence of no bot wall or CAPTCHA on the reading surface, confirmation that pages render as server-side HTML rather than a JS-only shell, and hands-on fetch results using an identified agent user agent.
